name: Lorekeeper Raintotem
summary: Lorekeeper Raintotem is a tauren elder stationed in northern Mulgore just south of Red Rocks. He tends to the sacred burial grounds and asks adventurers to drive off the Bristleback quilboar disturbing them.

sections.title: Watcher of Red Rocks
sections.body: Positioned near the sacred bluffs of Red Rocks in Mulgore, Lorekeeper Raintotem tends to the spiritual obligations of his people. He asks adventurers to drive Bristleback Interlopers from the burial ground, restoring peace to the ancestors' resting place.

sections.title: Defender of Ancestral Grounds
sections.body: Beyond testing fledgling heroes, Lorekeeper Raintotem watches over the hallowed burial sites at Red Rocks. When Bristleback quilboar interlopers disturb the sanctified resting places of deceased tauren chieftains and shamans, Raintotem enlists travelers to restore dignity and quiet the disturbed dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Lorekeeper Raintotem?
faq.answer: Lorekeeper Raintotem is stationed in northern Mulgore, located just south of Red Rocks along the path leading up toward the ancestral cliffs.

faq.q: Why does Raintotem seek help with the burial grounds?
faq.answer: He asks adventurers to drive Bristleback Interlopers from Red Rocks, where the quilboar are ravaging the sacred tauren burial ground.

faq.q: Why does Raintotem need help at Red Rocks?
faq.answer: Red Rocks serves as a sacred tauren burial ground, but Bristleback quilboar interlopers are ravaging the grave site. Raintotem tasks capable adventurers with putting the dishonored ancestral grounds back in order.

angles.text: Helping Raintotem defend Red Rocks honors the ancestors and preserves the burial traditions of your people.
Raintotem's vigilance over restless dead at Red Rocks directly concerns shamanic duty, ensuring ancestral spirits receive proper peace and reverence.
